audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was marked 'Skill' while the packet chart says Sylas, and the 2+ item stage was given to Renekton while the packet says Skill and the page's own late/whys[6] text says to avoid prolonged 1v1s.
audit.why: Hijack at 6 copies Dominus and comes back on 80s at rank 1 against Renekton's 120s, so the level-6 stage genuinely belongs to Sylas. The 48.79% win rate over 3751 games matches a lane that stops being Renekton's after the early levels.
audit.corrected: Level 6 flipped to Sylas (4/10) and 2+ items to Skill (5/10), both layers, as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: mid tells the player to 're-engage on his long ult cooldown'. Hijack is 80/55/30 — at rank 1 it is shorter than Renekton's own 120s Dominus, and by rank 3 it is 30s.
audit.why: Planning the whole level-6 window around a cooldown that is shorter than yours is backwards; the real plan is to make him spend the copy on nothing.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into whys[4], mid and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors repeated across the page. (1) Abscond / Abduct is called a 'dash + stun (recast pull)' in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t and wants.foe[1]. Riot's text: he dashes, and the recast throws chains to pull HIMSELF to an enemy hit. There is no stun. (2) The heal is repeatedly attributed to his Q as 'Q-drain' / 'Q-W drain'. Chain Lash (Q) damages and slows with a delayed explosion; the heal is Kingslayer (W), 12s at rank 1.
audit.why: The first tells the player to fear CC that does not exist and to burn engages baiting it; the second points Grievous Wounds and trade-length decisions at the wrong ability.
audit.corrected: Abscond described as dash plus self-pull with no stun; the heal attributed to Kingslayer with its 12s cooldown, in whys[3], spikes[3].text, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t and wants.foe[1].
sources: champ-data/_kits/sylas.json (Q, W, E text and cooldowns)

audit.why: report[8].t already prescribes Executioner's Calling early; the correction above also names Kingslayer as the heal so the item has a stated target.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds tied explicitly to Kingslayer in report[5].t.

edits.before: Dominus stats turn even fights into wins before 25 minutes. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Sylas's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Hijack copies Dominus and it is 80s at rank 1 against your 120s — make him spend the copy on nothing before you press yours.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Sylas carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items in, his heal outlasts short bursts. Sylas carry threat 8.5/10 — take the objective rather than the extended duel.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: 13s at rank 1 — a dash with a self-pull recast, not a stun, so it chases you rather than locking you. - Kingslayer: 12s, and it heals him off you. - Hijack: 80s at rank 1, shorter than your 120s Dominus.

edits.before: His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: A dash plus a self-pull recast — it does not stun. 13s at rank 1: bait it, then commit.

edits.before: Track Sylas's Abscond / Abduct: His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. When it is down — Fury W-stun + dash out.
edits.after: Abscond dashes and recasts into a self-pull — no stun, 13s at rank 1. Kingslayer heals off you: bring Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 his Q-W drain trades start matching your burst — keep exchanges short with the E-exit rather than slugging into his sustain.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 Kingslayer heals him off you every 12s while Chain Lash slows — keep exchanges short with the E exit instead of slugging into the heal.

edits.before: Sylas R at 6 copies Dominus and turns your HP-buffer window against you — bait the stolen ult before committing your own all-in.
edits.after: Hijack copies Dominus and turns your HP buffer against you — at 80s it returns faster than your 120s R, so never trade ultimates straight up.

edits.before: Sylas's Q-W drain keeps him relevant in extended skirmishes; avoid prolonged 1v1s and use your E to pick short-trade windows rather than grinding him down.
edits.after: Kingslayer's heal keeps him alive through extended skirmishes; avoid prolonged 1v1s and use your E to take short-trade windows rather than grinding him down.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are a genuine back-and-forth — his Q-W sustain means you cannot grind him down in a long trade, so keep hitting and leaving with the E exit dash rather than slugging it out. At level 6 the matchup flips temporarily: Sylas R steals your Dominus, giving him your HP buffer and Fury ramp to use right back at you. Never pop your own R the moment you both hit 6; force him to blow the stolen copy first on a fake all-in, then re-engage on his long ult cooldown with your real Dominus active.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are a genuine back-and-forth — Kingslayer heals him off you every 12s, so you cannot grind him down; keep hitting and leaving with the E exit rather than slugging it out. At level 6 the lane flips: Hijack steals Dominus and hands him your HP buffer and Fury ramp. Never pop your own R the moment you both hit 6. Force the copy out on a fake all-in and punish immediately — Hijack is 80s at rank 1 but only 30s at rank 3, so that window shrinks every time he ranks it.

edits.before: Land E chain-dash stun to interrupt your empowered W-stun setup and swing the all-in
edits.after: Recast Abduct to pull himself back onto you after your E exit so the trade runs long

notes: Two false mechanics were load-bearing on this page: Abscond/Abduct was described as a stun (it is a dash with a self-pull recast, no CC), and the healing was attributed to Chain Lash (it is Kingslayer). The stolen-ult plan was also built on Hijack being a long cooldown — it is 80s at rank 1 and 30s at rank 3, shorter than Renekton's own R at every rank. Mirror sylas__renekton not yet audited.
